name: ContinuousOn.exists_greatest_zero_of_nonpos_of_pos
statement:
lemma ContinuousOn.exists_greatest_zero_of_nonpos_of_pos {g : ℝ → ℝ} {t₀ t₁ : ℝ}
    (hg_cont : ContinuousOn g (Icc t₀ t₁))
    (ht : t₀ < t₁) (hg_start : g t₀ ≤ 0) (hg_end : 0 < g t₁) :
    ∃ a ∈ Ico t₀ t₁, g a = 0 ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioc a t₁, 0 < g t

name: sSup_mem_of_isClosed
statement:
lemma sSup_mem_of_isClosed {S : Set ℝ}
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hBdd : BddAbove S) (hCl : IsClosed S) : sSup S ∈ S

name: Continuous.intervalIntegrable_comp
statement:
lemma Continuous.intervalIntegrable_comp {t₀ t₁ : ℝ} (hle : t₀ ≤ t₁)
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {f : ℝ → E → E} {z : ℝ → E}
    (hf_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => f p.1 p.2))
    (hz : ContinuousOn z (Icc t₀ t₁)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun s => f s (z s)) volume t₀ t₁

name: ContinuousOn.integral_sub_adjacent_intervals
statement:
lemma ContinuousOn.integral_sub_adjacent_intervals {a t : ℝ} {μ : ℝ → ℝ} {s : ℝ}
    (hμ_t : ContinuousOn μ (Icc a t))
    (hs : s ∈ Icc a t) :
    (∫ τ in a..t, μ τ) - ∫ τ in a..s, μ τ = ∫ τ in s..t, μ τ

name: antitoneOn_halfWindow_average
statement:
lemma antitoneOn_halfWindow_average {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf_anti : AntitoneOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hf_int : ∀ a b, 0 < a → 0 < b → IntervalIntegrable f volume a b) :
    AntitoneOn (fun η => (2 / η) * ∫ s in (η / 2)..η, f s) (Set.Ioi 0)

name: intervalIntegral.integral_const_eq
statement:
lemma intervalIntegral.integral_const_eq {a b C : ℝ} :
    ∫ _ in a..b, C = (b - a) * C

name: intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_const_mul
intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_mul
statement:
lemma intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_mul {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {u : ℝ → E} {v : ℝ → ℝ} {a b L : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hu_norm_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => ‖u s‖) volume a b)
    (hv_int : IntervalIntegrable v volume a b)
    (h_bound : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, ‖u s‖ ≤ L * v s) :
    ‖∫ s in a..b, u s‖ ≤ L * ∫ s in a..b, v s

name: diniDerivRight_add_differentiable
statement:
theorem diniDerivRight_add_differentiable {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hf_bdd_below : IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hf_bdd_above : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g t) :
    D⁺ (fun s => f s + g s) t = D⁺ f t + deriv g t

name: diniDerivRight_add_le
statement:
theorem diniDerivRight_add_le {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hf_bdd_below : IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hf_bdd_above : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hg_cobdd_below : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (g (t + h) - g t) / h))
    (hg_bdd_above : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (g (t + h) - g t) / h)) :
    D⁺ (fun s => f s + g s) t ≤ D⁺ f t + D⁺ g t

name: diniDerivRight_add_linear
statement:
theorem diniDerivRight_add_linear (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c t : ℝ)
    (hf_bdd_below : IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hf_bdd_above : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h)) :
    D⁺ (fun s => f s + c * s) t = D⁺ f t + c

name: diniDerivRight_const_mul_pos
statement:
theorem diniDerivRight_const_mul_pos {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ)
    (hbdd : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hcobdd : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h)) :
    D⁺ (fun s => c * f s) t = c * D⁺ f t

name: diniDerivRight_le_iff
statement:
theorem diniDerivRight_le_iff {f : ℝ → ℝ} {t L : ℝ}
    (hbdd : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hcobdd : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h)) :
    D⁺ f t ≤ L ↔
    ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[>] 0, (f (t + h) - f t) / h ≤ L + ε

name: le_diniDerivRight_iff
statement:
theorem le_diniDerivRight_iff {f : ℝ → ℝ} {t L : ℝ}
    (hbdd : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hcobdd : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h)) :
    L ≤ D⁺ f t ↔
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ᶠ h in 𝓝[>] 0, L - ε < (f (t + h) - f t) / h

name: limsup_add_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma limsup_add_tendsto_zero {ι : Type*} {f g : ι → ℝ} {l : Filter ι} [l.NeBot]
    (hbdd_below : IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) l f)
    (hbdd_above : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) l f)
    (hg : Tendsto g l (𝓝 0)) :
    limsup (f + g) l = limsup f l

name: neg_diniDerivRight_neg_le
statement:
theorem neg_diniDerivRight_neg_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hbdd_above : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h))
    (hbdd_below : IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (𝓝[>] 0) (fun h => (f (t + h) - f t) / h)) :
    -(D⁺ (fun s => -f s) t) ≤ D⁺ f t

name: LinearSystems.hautusControllabilityMatrix_transpose
statement:
lemma hautusControllabilityMatrix_transpose
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (μ : ℂ) :
    (hautusControllabilityMatrix A B μ)ᵀ = hautusObservabilityMatrix Aᵀ Bᵀ μ

name: LinearSystems.hautusObservabilityMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma hautusObservabilityMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (C : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (μ : ℂ) (v : Fin n → ℂ) :
    hautusObservabilityMatrix A C μ *ᵥ v = 0
      ↔ A *ᵥ v = μ • v ∧ C *ᵥ v = 0
